title: Python for Everybody
description: A gentle introduction to programming with Python for complete beginners. Covers syntax, control flow, functions and basic data structures with small practical exercises.

title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python
description: Practical Python taught through small automation projects: files, spreadsheets, web scraping. Reinforces core syntax by building things rather than drilling theory.

title: NumPy Fundamentals
description: Official beginner guide to ndarrays, vectorised operations, indexing and broadcasting. Short and reference-grade rather than narrative.

title: Pandas in 10 Minutes and Beyond
description: Whirlwind tour of DataFrame creation, selection, grouping and merging. Best used as a first orientation before deeper practice.

title: Data Analysis with Python
description: Full course on analysing real datasets with pandas and NumPy, including cleaning and summarising data. Ends with graded projects on actual data.

title: Cleaning Messy Data in Pandas
description: Walks through missing values, type coercion, duplicates and outliers on a messy real dataset. Practical patterns rather than API listings.

title: SQL for Data Analysis
description: Interactive SQL tutorial aimed squarely at analysts, from SELECT through joins and aggregation, run against real datasets in the browser.

title: SQLBolt Interactive Lessons
description: Short interactive SQL lessons with immediate feedback. Ideal first contact with querying for someone who has never written SQL.

title: Advanced SQL: Window Functions
description: Focused treatment of window functions: partitions, ranking and running aggregates, with analyst-oriented examples.

title: Database Design Fundamentals
description: Official tutorial covering tables, keys, relationships and basic schema design in a real relational database.

title: Statistics Fundamentals
description: Structured coverage of descriptive statistics, distributions and probability with lots of worked practice problems.

title: Intro to Inferential Statistics
description: Visual, interactive introduction to sampling, estimation and hypothesis testing. Strong for building intuition before formal study.

title: Data Visualization with Python
description: Building charts that answer questions, covering distributions, comparisons and relationships, plus common misleading-chart pitfalls.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis Project
description: Hands-on notebooks where you clean and explore a real dataset end to end and publish your findings.

title: Feature Engineering for Machine Learning
description: Encoding categoricals, scaling, interaction terms and target encoding, evaluated against a real predictive task.

title: Intro to Machine Learning
description: First supervised models with scikit-learn: decision trees and random forests, with train/validation discipline introduced early.

title: Machine Learning Crash Course
description: Google's structured ML introduction: loss, gradient descent, generalisation, regularisation and evaluation, with interactive exercises.

title: scikit-learn User Guide: Model Selection
description: Reference-grade coverage of cross-validation, hyperparameter search and scoring metrics with runnable examples.

title: Clustering and Dimensionality Reduction
description: Unsupervised methods including k-means, hierarchical clustering and PCA, with guidance on when each applies.

title: Build an Analyst Portfolio Dashboard
description: End-to-end project: query a dataset, design the charts, assemble a dashboard, and write the narrative a stakeholder would read.

title: Storytelling with Data
description: Essays on framing analysis for decision-makers: choosing the message, removing clutter and structuring the narrative.

title: Analyst Capstone: End-to-End Case Study
description: Take a real dataset from raw files to a documented, evaluated model with a written conclusion. Consolidates the whole analyst workflow.

title: Learn HTML
description: Modern HTML from the ground up: document structure, semantics, forms and metadata, written by browser engineers.

title: Learn CSS
description: Comprehensive modern CSS: the box model, selectors, colour, typography and the cascade, with interactive demos.

title: CSS Grid and Flexbox Guides
description: The reference guides for grid and flexbox, with visual diagrams for every property. Best kept open while building layouts.

title: JavaScript Basics
description: Careful, example-led introduction to JavaScript syntax, types, functions and objects. Deeper than most beginner material.

title: Modern JavaScript: Modules and ES6+
description: Modules, destructuring, spread, classes and the tooling that assumes them. Bridges beginner JS to framework-ready JS.

title: Asynchronous JavaScript Deep Dive
description: Callbacks, promises, async/await, error handling and the event loop, with the failure modes made explicit.

title: TypeScript Handbook
description: Official handbook: types, interfaces, generics, narrowing and configuration. Reference-shaped, best consumed in sections.

title: React Foundations
description: Official tutorial: components, props, state, lists and events, with the mental model of rendering explained properly.

title: Thinking in React Hooks
description: Reference and guidance for useState, useEffect, useMemo and custom hooks, including when effects are the wrong tool.

title: Managing State in React
description: Structuring state, lifting it up, context, and reducers, with worked refactors of realistic components.

title: Next.js App Router Course
description: Build and deploy a full Next.js application: routing, layouts, data fetching, server components and deployment.

title: Node.js and Express Fundamentals
description: Server-side JavaScript: the runtime, npm, Express routing, middleware and connecting to a database.

title: Designing REST APIs
description: HTTP methods, status codes, headers and caching, which is the substrate every REST design decision sits on.

title: Web Authentication and Sessions
description: Sessions, cookies, tokens, password hashing and the common attacks each mechanism is defending against.

title: Accessibility Fundamentals
description: Semantics, focus management, contrast, ARIA and testing with a screen reader. Practical and standards-grounded.

title: Learn Git Branching
description: Visual, interactive Git: commits, branching, merging and rebasing, with the graph drawn as you type commands.

title: Testing JavaScript Applications
description: Unit, integration and end-to-end testing strategy, including what to test and what not to bother testing.

title: Deploy a Full-Stack App
description: Take an application from local development to a live URL: builds, environment variables, previews and rollbacks.

title: Build a Portfolio Web App
description: Capstone project building and deploying a full-stack application, integrating front end, API, database and auth.
